description: Prepare unsigned, reviewed swap calldata for local signing on Base Aerodrome Slipstream, Base PancakeSwap V3, the Base agent swap guard, or a Solana Loopscale vault deposit. Use it when the user wants an executable transaction bound to a reviewed pool and policy. Do not use it to sign, submit or route arbitrary calldata, and do not skip the matching safety gate. Returns the unsigned transaction envelope (to/value/calldata), reviewed profile, quote and, where supported, a signed decision. Deprecated alias: prefer trade_guard with op "prepare_swap". Removed on 2027-01-06.

amount_in.description: Exact input amount as a decimal string

input_mint.description: Solana base58 mint sold; required for venue=solana_jupiter

output_mint.description: Solana base58 mint bought; required for venue=solana_jupiter

name: prepare_swap
